---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? Who benefits and how often?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposal better?

## Architecture Impact

Does this feature affect:
- [ ] Domain layer (new entities, value objects, domain events)
- [ ] Application layer (new use cases)
- [ ] Infrastructure (new database access patterns)
- [ ] HTTP API (new endpoints or changes to existing ones)
- [ ] Frontend (new pages or components)
- [ ] Configuration (new environment variables)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Additional Context

Links, mockups, or references to similar implementations.
